subject: Deployment mode & integrations: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (SSO / KMS / Logging)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode & integration needs (recap + next steps)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can prioritize the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem).

TL;DR from the call:
- Primary constraint: customer-managed key material and HSM support is a hard requirement for production PII workloads.
- SSO: SAML-based SSO with SCIM provisioning required for your org (Okta).
- Logging & retention: audit + request logs need to be retained for 13 months and exportable to your SIEM (Splunk).
- Network: VPC peering or private connectivity required for any production traffic.

What this implies (high level):
- Hosted API: unlikely to meet HSM ownership and VPC requirement out-of-the-box. Could work only if you accept Redwood-managed keys + secure routing (not preferred based on today).
- Dedicated: offers reserved GPU pools and more network isolation; can sometimes meet org-level SSO and logging needs but typically still uses Redwood-managed KMS unless we enable customer KMS + HSM integration (depends on the size of the commit and contract).
- Private (VPC/on-prem): the safest path to meet all three constraints — customer KMS/HSM, SAML SCIM SSO, and direct logging retention in your environment.

Requested next steps from our side:
1) Tech deep-dive with you + your security/infra (ok to include Priya?) to validate KMS/HSM options and network topology — propose 60m slot next week.
2) I will share a compact checklist (network, KMS, SSO, logging, regulatory) and an architecture comparison doc (Attached: redwood-dedicated-vs-private-arch.pdf).
3) Pricing/commit outline and lead times — I will send a Dedicated vs Private cost/commit sketch after the tech deep-dive.

Action items for you: please confirm:
- Is Priya from infra available for the deep-dive?
- Any existing internal docs that describe your HSM provider, KMS requirements, or preferred CIEM/SIEM endpoints?

Attaching: redwood-dedicated-vs-private-arch.pdf (high-level), fintechco-integration-checklist.xlsx (blank checklist template).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & integration needs (recap + next steps)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Priya and I reviewed and a few clarifications/questions from our side:

1) KMS/HSM: we require customer-managed keys with an HSM-backed provider (Thales or AWS CloudHSM). The keys must be under our control (you should be able to support either BYOK via KMS import or an HSM-backed KMS solution).
2) SSO: SAML 2.0 with IdP-initiated login and SCIM for provisioning. We use Okta for groups and provisioning.
3) Logging: we need at least 13 months retention for request-level logs and audit trails. Logs must be pushable to our Splunk indexer or exported daily to an S3 bucket.
4) Network: we prefer private connectivity (VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink).

Given those constraints, our security lead is leaning towards Private VPC/on-prem, but procurement will want a cost comparison vs Dedicated (in case we can accept an AzureHSM or an alternative flow). Can you share:
- A short doc that maps which options require what (i.e., which KMS/HSM configurations are supported by Dedicated vs Private)
- A proposed timeline and lead times to stand up Private vs Dedicated for a first prod pilot
- SOC 2 Type II report and pen-test summary (we can provide an NDA if needed)

We are available for a technical deep-dive next Tuesday 2026-03-09 10:00-11:30 PT or Wednesday 2026-03-10 09:00-10:30 PT.

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform Security | FinTechCo
samir.gupta@fintechco.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
